Industrialisation : Mettre en place les processus de fabrication et garantir leur conformité aux exigences techniques. Rédaction technique : Rédiger les cahiers des charges pour les équipements, établir les documentations et assurer le suivi des appels d’offres. Analyse économique et gestion des investissements : Évaluer la rentabilité des projets, formuler des demandes d’investissement et suivre les budgets. Coordination et collaboration : Assurer la communication et la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Mise en service des équipements : Assurer la mise en service des installations de montage et de test, y compris la formation des équipes de production. Ramp-up et tests : Gérer le déploiement des processus et tests pour les produits Swatch et Flik Flak. • INDUSTRIALIZZAZIONE DEL PROGETTO 100% sul sito
• Gestione dei progetti industriali: Progetti pilota relativi all'integrazione di nuovi mezzi di produzione e ottimizzazione dei processi di montaggio.
• Industrializzazione: implementare processi produttivi e garantire il rispetto dei requisiti tecnici.
• Elaborazione tecnica: Progetto di specifiche per le attrezzature, preparazione di documentazione e follow-up delle offerte.
• Analisi economica e gestione degli investimenti: Valutare la redditività del progetto, fare richieste di investimento e monitorare i budget.
• Coordinamento e collaborazione: assicurare la comunicazione e il coordinamento con i team interni e con i partner esterni.
• Equipaggiamento messa in servizio: Assicurare la messa in servizio di impianti di assemblaggio e collaudo, compresa la formazione di squadre di produzione.
• Supporto di processo: fornire supporto tecnico nell'evoluzione del prodotto e garantire l'ottimizzazione dei processi durante il loro ciclo di vita.
• Ramp-up e test: gestire la distribuzione di processi e test per i prodotti Swatch e Flik Flak.

CHEF/FE DE PROJECT INDUSTRIALIZATION 100% on site

• HEAD/FE DE PROJECT INDUSTRIALIZATION 100% on site
• Your future missionsIndustrial project management: Pilot projects related to the integration of new means of production and optimization of assembly processes.
• Industrialization: Implement manufacturing processes and ensure compliance with technical requirements.
• Technical drafting: Draft specifications for equipment, prepare documentation and follow-up of tenders.
• Economic Analysis and Investment Management: Assess project profitability, make investment requests and monitor budgets.
• Coordination and collaboration: Ensure communication and coordination with internal teams and external partners.
• Equipment commissioning: Ensure the commissioning of assembly and testing facilities, including the training of production teams.
• Process support: Provide technical support in product evolution and ensure process optimization throughout their life cycle.
• Ramp-up and tests: Manage the deployment of processes and tests for Swatch and Flik Flak products.
• Your skills and skillsA graduate degree in microtechnics, mechanics, automation or a related technical field
• Flexible, agile and stress-resistant, you are solution oriented and have good persuasion strength
• Autonomous, proactive and with a strong spirit of initiative, you are inventive and pragmatic
• Open to consensus and with a strong team spirit, you nevertheless have a good strength of persuasion
• You have an excellent sense of communication
• Apply
• LanguagesMastery of French, good knowledge of German and/or English required
• What you will find in usAn exciting environment in perpetual evolution as well as attractive benefits such as:
• Opportunities for continuing training
• Multiple job opportunities thanks to our internal mobility
• Five or six weeks of vacation per year according to age and/or function
• 40-hour week according to CTC
• Attractive wage policy and good social benefits
• Three-week parental leave for fathers and up to 19 weeks for mothers
• Business restaurant
• Reductions for staff on Swatch Group products and other partners
• Sports activities and corporate events
• Financial contribution to health insurance

• Close to public transport

• Technischer Entwurf: Entwurf von Spezifikationen für die Ausrüstung, Vorbereitung der Dokumentation und Weiterverfolgung von Ausschreibungen.

• Ramp-up und Tests: Verwalten Sie die Bereitstellung von Prozessen und Tests für Swatch und Flik Flak Produkte.
